intent_summary: Compare current events with explicitly declared prior local-calendar windows at equivalent clock progress, exposing selection evidence while preserving existing distribution tests and testing allocations.

criteria.criterion: Explicit daily, same-weekday or weekday/weekend matching selects only earlier local-calendar windows and records selected and excluded observations.
A partial current window is compared with the same local-clock progress in prior windows, with explicit handling of timezone and daylight-saving boundaries.
Minimum measured support across distinct prior windows gates inference; any broader daily fallback is declared in advance and visibly reported.
Selected numeric or categorical events reuse the existing distribution tests and retain the caller's repeated-comparison allocation without creating a fresh testing budget.
Reference selection is deterministic and inspectable, with no automatic season discovery, inferred business comparability or claim that seasonal matching removes within-batch dependence.
